verdict.rationale: Canny's Autopilot automatically captures feedback and pulls feature requests out of support, sales, review and call-transcript sources. The MCP server also lets an LLM surface top themes and organize requests. However, no evidence explicitly says Autopilot links the detected insights to existing feature ideas, and the docs never describe the AI mechanics behind detection. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that AI automatically matches or links extracted feedback to existing ideas or posts, detail on how insight detection works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
